FY2025 (EPS 6.61, net income 5,221m) from the FY2025 press release (airbus.com, 19 Feb 2026); 9m 2025 (3.34; 2,641m) and 9m 2026 (4.54; 3,587m) from the 9m 2026 press release. EPS is reported (basic); diluted FY2025 is 6.60. One-offs are the company's own EBIT adjustments. Q4 2025 by difference: FY2025 list (FX mismatch -624, Spirit -188, workforce plan -105, A400M -73, other -56; total -1,046) minus 9m 2025 list (FX -577, workforce -105, Spirit -88, other -11; total -781; read in an archived copy of the 9m 2025 press release on bnains.org because airbus.com returned a bot-protection page) = FX -47, Spirit -100, A400M -73, other -45. 9m 2026: FX +270, Spirit -235, workforce plan +60, other -40 (total +55). All amounts are pre-tax; converted with the FY2025 effective tax rate 21.9% (my arithmetic; the company does not disclose the tax effect per item): gains 223 x 0.781 / 6,167 = 2.8% and 60 x 0.781 / 6,167 = 0.8%; offsets 335 x 0.781 / 6,167 = 4.2% and 158 x 0.781 / 6,167 = 2.0%. Offsets exceed gains, so no reduction. The FX mismatch is a recurring item that changes sign (it was -624m in FY2025); listing it as a one-off gain is conservative. Financial result TTM = 268 - 374 + 155 = +49m (mainly revaluation of equity investments and Airbus Ventures funds; under 1% of profit, not listed). Guidance is for EBIT Adjusted, not EPS, so left empty. Cross-check with dataset: 206.65 / 26.49 = 7.80 vs document 7.81.
